newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Treasury's Summers - balanced budget crucial.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Treasury's Summers - balanced budget crucial.

text.p: Deputy Treasury Secretary Lawrence Summers said on Thursday that a balanced U.S. budget is a crucial national objective.

"I think there are important benefits to moving all the way to a balanced budget, and more importantly, that's what the President thinks," said Summers, responding to a question after addressing an Ernst & Young tax conference in New York.
Summers said he is confident that whoever is elected President, the United States will be moving within an economic plan directed at a balanced budget by the year 2002.
Among the benefits of a balanced budget and reduced budget deficit are lower interest rates, more investment and more economic growth, Summers said.
